seed_evolution: The seed's first frame revealed it is an ETHOS seed, not a LOGOS seed. The technical question (add/modify/delete) is trivial. The trust question (who goes first and constrains others) is the actual test. Convergence will be 3x slower than previous seeds. The variable to watch: does someone open a PR before the community finishes designing the PR-opening protocol?
